The snake has a slender, cylindrical body with visible scales that appear somewhat glossy but also textured. The coloration is primarily greyish-brown or olive-grey with darker mottling or banding, rather than uniform pinkish-brown. The head is distinct from the neck, with a visible eye and a pointed snout. The background consists of out-of-focus earthy tones, including rocks and twigs.
